nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address public owner, initialized to msg.sender and enforced by the onlyOwner modifier
mapping(address=>mapping(uint=>uint)) public balance: per-beneficiary per-unlock-timestamp locked token amounts
IERC20 public token: ERC20 token that is being timelocked by this contract
uint public totalBalance: sum of all tokens currently locked in the contract
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) internal pure, overflow-checked multiplication
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) internal pure, division-by-zero checked division
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure, underflow-checked subtraction
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure, overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) internal pure, modulo with zero-check
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
Ownable.transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner: hands contract ownership to newOwner
TimeMachineP.getTimestamp_ internal view returns block.timestamp (time source for lock maturity)
SafeERC20Timelock constructor(address _token): sets token = IERC20(_token)
contractBalance_ internal view returns token.balanceOf(this)
accept(address _for,uint _timestamp,uint _tvalue) public: pulls tokens with transferFrom and records a lock entry
release_ internal: loops over timestamp/value arrays, validates maturity, debits balance and transfers tokens
release(uint[] _timestamp,uint[] _value) external: releases locks owned by msg.sender
releaseForce(address _for,uint[] _timestamp,uint[] _value) external: releases locks of an arbitrary beneficiary without consent
saveLockedERC20Tokens(address _token,address _to,uint _amount) onlyOwner external: moves arbitrary ERC20 tokens out of this contract
Fallback function, payable, always reverts to reject plain ETH transfers
SafeERC20TimelockProd constructor: deploys SafeERC20Timelock with hardcoded token address
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership assignment, transferFrom source and release beneficiary
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time returned by getTimestamp_ and used for lock maturity checks
External call token.transferFrom(msg.sender,this,_tvalue) inside accept, executed before balance/totalBalance are updated
External call token.transfer(_for,_totalValue) at the end of release_
External call IERC20(_token).transfer(_to,_amount) in saveLockedERC20Tokens with a caller-supplied token address
uint arithmetic combining SafeMath add/sub results that is written into balance and totalBalance
_token parameter of the SafeERC20Timelock constructor
_for parameter of accept: future token holder address
_timestamp parameter of accept: lock maturity timestamp
_tvalue parameter of accept: amount of tokens the caller locks
_for parameter of release_: beneficiary whose locks are released
_timestamp array parameter of release_: timestamps to unlock
_value array parameter of release_: amounts to unlock
_timestamp array parameter of the external release function
_value array parameter of the external release function
_for parameter of releaseForce: arbitrary beneficiary supplied by the caller
_timestamp array parameter of releaseForce
_value array parameter of releaseForce
_token parameter of saveLockedERC20Tokens: arbitrary ERC20 contract to call
_to parameter of saveLockedERC20Tokens: arbitrary recipient address
_amount parameter of saveLockedERC20Tokens: amount to transfer
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership: next contract owner
_contractBalance local in accept: token balance snapshot taken before transferFrom
_balance local in accept: existing balance[_for][_timestamp] value
_totalBalance local in accept: totalBalance snapshot
_value local in accept: actually received token amount computed by subtraction
_len local in release_: length of the timestamp array
_totalValue local in release_: accumulated value to transfer
_curValue local in release_: balance entry for the current timestamp
_curTimestamp local in release_: current loop timestamp
_subValue local in release_: amount to subtract for the current entry
_now local in release_: cached getTimestamp_() value
i loop counter in release_
